༄༅/ /thub pa'i bstan srung dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i las mtha' man ngag gter gyi bang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thub pa'i bstan srung dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i las mtha' man ngag gter gyi bang mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

thub pa'i bstan srung dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i las mtha' man ngag gter gyi bang mdzod ces bya ba/ shrī ma hā kā lā mched brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di la gdams pa nyer gsum las/ klu gtad/ sa bdag spyi gtad/ mnan pa/ 'gom chog /bskrad pa/ than 'gyed/ jag 'ching*/ zhing sel/ khang sel/ nor sel/ dur sel/ thog 'bebs/ ser 'bebs/ sad 'bebs| zas sbyor/ mdze gtong ba/ smyo byed/ du ba rlung zhon/ klad srin gtong ba/ lhog pa gtong ba/ sha rul ba/ hur sod/ 'brug gtad rnams yod pa las/ ༈ /dang po klu gtad ni/ liṅga dpe'u ris ltar bris pa'i khong par ming rus dmod mo rgyas par bris la dgra yi dri rdzas dang mdze khrag dug sna tshogs khrag dang sbyar la byug /las byang gzhung bsrang 'gugs 'dren mang du byas la/ liṅga sngo dmar gyis bcings la mdze thod dam/ mdze rkang ngam/ glang rwar bcug /re bas dril rgyas btab la/ klu bdud gnas nges pa'i mtsho chen po'am chu mig kha byang phyogs su lta bar thebs dang bstun la gtad/ rang nyid srung 'khor rgyas par bsgom mo// des dgra bo lo mi 'gor bar gri thabs su 'chi ba the tshom med do// zab bo gaṃ bhī ra/ ༈ /gnyis pa sa bdag spyi gtad ni/ liṅga dpe'u chung ltar la tha ma mgon po brgyad kyi bsad sngags kyis bskor ba phyi rol dza khram bri khong par ming rus dmod mo rgyas par bri/ phag khrag dang khrag sna dgra'i dri rdzas rnams khrag dang sbyar la byug /las byang gzhung bsrang 'gugs 'dren mang du byas la/ liṅga bltabs la tshon skud sna lngas bcings shing*/ g.yag gam mdzo rwa g.yas par bcug kha re bas dril rgyas btab la/ sa bdag gnas nges pa'i ri brag shing sogs la gtad/ rang nyid bsrung ba la 'bad/ des ni dgra bo dgu rgyud dang bcas pa myur du 'chi nges so// sa ma ya kha thaṃ/ ༈ /gsum pa mnan pa ni/ liṅga dpe'u ris ltar bris la khong par dgra dang bgegs kyi ming dmod mo dang bcas pa bri/

khrag sna dug sna sa sna rnams byug /las byang gzhung bsrang 'gugs stim mang du byas la bltab/ tshon skud kyis bcings la/ sa'i ga'u gru gsum du bcug la re bas dril rgyas btab la lha khang ngam/ mchod rten nam/ zam rnga'am/ lam rgya gram sogs su mnan/ dong kha ro g.yam la rdo rje rgya gram ri rab bris pas bcad do// de ni dgra bgegs gang yin yang lus ngag yid gsum nyams par byed do// zab rgya rgya rgya/ ༈ /bzhi pa 'gom chog ni/ 'khor lo sngags dang bcas pa dpe'u ris ltar bris la/ liṅga'i khong par ming rus dmod pa dang bcas pa bris la/ sngags pa dam ldan gyi dri ma/ dge slong sdom ldan gyi dri ma/ lha khang byin rlabs can gyi sa/ mchod rten rab gnas can gyi sa| nal bu'i khrag /ro bsregs pa'i gzhob/ dme khrag /mdze khrag /btsan dug rnams byugs shing rus pas bdug /las byang gzhung bsrang 'gugs 'dren mang du byas la bltab/ sāts+tsha rab gnas can gnyis 'phong sprad pa'i bar du bcug tshon skud kyis bcings la kho'i rgyu srang du sbas so// de la khos 'gom pas bsod nams thams cad skad cig la nyams nas mi 'dod pa sna tshogs 'byung ngo*// 'gom chog la khyi dang byi las ma 'gom pa gal che zhing*/ rang gi dri dang grib ma ma phog par bya'o// zab dha thim/ ༈ /lnga pa bskrad pa ni/ 'khor lo sngags rnams dpe'u ris ltar bris pa'i lte bar ming rus dmod pa rgyas par bri/ dgra'i dri rdzas dang dug khrag byug /las byang gzhung bsrang 'gugs 'dren mang du byas la bltab/ shas dril rgyus pas btsems la pho rog la byin zos ma thag tu yul gzhan la bskrad la btang*/ des ni dgra bo yul rtsad nas 'byin par byed do// / ༈ /drug pa than 'gyed ni/ kam pa la a tsa ras spre'u zhon pa/ sre mos gla ba zhon pa/ sbal pas sbrul zhon pa/ sdig pas rtsangs pa zhon pa/ pho rog gis 'ug pa zhon pa rnams bzos la rbad sngags kyi sham bur rang gi nor gang shor dang dgra'i ming rus dmod mo bris par rang rang gi sha khrag gis byugs la bcug

/mdun du 'bru nag gi tshom bu lnga'i dbus su a tsa ra/ mdun du sre mo// g.yas su sbal pa/ rgyab tu sdig pa/ g.yon du pho rog rnams kha dgra phyogs su bstan la bzhag /las byang gzhung bsrang la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ badz+ra tri sarba a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dzaḥdzaḥ rbad rbad/ gang gang*/ gong gong*/ mag mag /mug mug /myag myag /myog myog /rgyugs/ rgyugs/ dgra bo'i steng du rgyugs/ nga'i ka cha khyer ma'i khyim du rgyugs/ 'o dod bos| brang rdungs/ than thong*/ sgo rdungs/ bro khrobs/ skra 'bol/ 'gram lcag rgyob/ me bus/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad thong zhig sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo rbad rbad/ ces nyi ma shar nas dmar thag ma chad bar du ngag bcad bzlas shing ram bu'i thun brab/ sa sros nas dgra phyogs su than gzugs rnams kha bstan la 'phang*/ rbad sngags bzlas thun brab bo// des ni dgra yi khyim du ji ltar rbad pa bzhin myur du 'ong ba the tshom med do// 'di ni nor che chung gang shor ba'i gting du rbad kyang 'gro'o// zab rgya/ ༈ /bdun pa jag 'ching ni/ rgyun chen 'brong gi rnga ma/ yug sa'i skra/ gri skra rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgril ba'i skud pa mtho gsum la/ rdo rje'i mdud pa dgu rgyab la/ oṃ badz+ra kā lā ya tri sa ma ya/ chom rkun jag pa'i bla chings/ yid chings/ sems chings/ stobs nus rtsal chings/ rengs rengs/ sarba du tri 'dus 'dus rbad rbad/ ces khri tsho gcig btab la rang gi lus la btags| 'jigs pa che sar sngags stong bzlas la srad bu la bsngags/ sa la sngags btab ste 'jigs pa'i phyogs su gtor ro// des ni 'jigs pa las skyob par the tshom med do// sa ma ya rgya/ ༈ /brgyad pa zhing sel ni/ sngags dpe'u ris ltar bris la/ drod sman hril ljong*/ ga pur/ gla rtsi/ bab bla/ mu zi/ lhong ros/ khrag sna/ dug sna/ sa sna rnams byugs la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sarba ya ma ra du tri trig nan hur thuṃ dz+wa la raṃ e yaṃ yaṃ raṃ raṃ baṃ baṃ laṃ laṃ 'khrug 'khrug

/skoṃ skoṃ/ zhes khri tsho gcig bzlas la gdab/ sngags mjug nas dril la rab chad kyi rkang du bcug la re bas dril nas dgra'i zhing dkyil du sba'o// des ni lo tog skye mi srid do// ༈ /dgu pa khang sel ni/ ga pur/ drod sman hril 'jong*/ shing tshe zad/ sa tshe zad/ rdo tshe zad/ mchod rten nag po'i sa rnams la/ badz+ra ma hā kā lā 'byung ba 'khrugs 'khrugs/ khrol khrol/ shig shig /ces khri tsho gcig btab la rdzas la bsngags mdze pho'i rkang du bcug re bas dril la/ dgra'i khang rmang du sba'o// des ni dgra yi khang pa myur du 'jig pa the tshom med do// zab rgya rgya rgya/ ༈ /bcu pa nor sel ni/ god 'dre'i gzugs dpe'u chung ltar bris pa'i khong par dgra bo che ge mo 'di'i nor shi bar gyis/ god kha phyes/ brlag tu chug /nor zad par gyis/ mdzod stong par gyis/ zhes bris la lha khang 'dre can gyi sa dang gzhi bdag gdug pa can gnas pa'i sa rnams byugs la gri rkang du bcug dgra'i bres mthongs su sba/ phung shor gyi sa bres dang nor la gtor ro/ /des ni kho yi nor thams cad brlag par 'gyur ro/ /zab dha thim/// / ༈ /bcu gcig pa dur sel ni/ liṅga dpe'u chung ltar bris pa'i khong par/ dgra bo che ge mo'i dur kha phyes shig /shi kha phyes shig /gza' skar spar sme lo zla zhag dus kyi dur kha ngan pa thams cad dgra bo 'di la phyes shig /dur 'di dgra bo bdun rgyud dang bcas pa'i ros gang bar gyis shig /lha srin sde brgyad kyis dgra bo che ge mo 'di'i dur kha phyes shig /ces bris la dug khrag byug /las byang gzhung bsrang 'gugs 'dren mang po byas la bltab/ shi skras bcings shing rabs chad kyi thod par bcug la pha mes kyi dur sar mnan no// des ni dgra bo'i dur kha phye ste lo re la mi re 'chi bar 'gyur ro// ༈ /bcu gnyis pa thog 'bebs ni/ mi rta khyi/ ri bong lug 'phyi ba/ stag dom glang po che/

gzig sbrul spyang ki dred spre'u de rnams kyi khrag ril bu dril te bskams la/ oṃ ma hā kā lā a mu ka badz+ra ā we sha ya mā ra ya dgra bo che ge mo'i khang thog tu myur du phob ya bh+yo bh+yo/ /zhes 'bum tsho gcig btab la ril bu dgra'i khang thog tu bsreg go/ /des ni dgra'i khang thog tu thog 'byung ngo*/ /sa ma ya kha thaṃ/ ༈ /bcu gsum pa ser 'bebs ni/ gri khrag /dme khrag /mdze khrag /yug khrag /rta khrag /khyi khrag /rkyang khrag /bong khrag /phag khrag /sdom sha/ sdig sha/ sbal sha/ sbrul sha/ lcong mo'i sha/ nya sha/ rtsangs pa'i sha/ phye ma leb kyi sha/ ldong ros/ btsan dug /bab bla/ gla rtsi/ mu zi ser po/ shu dag /gu gul/ mu zi nag po/ zi ra nag po rnams bsres la ser ba'i chus sbrus la ril bu lug ril tsam dril la bskam/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ gnam shigs shigs ser ser raṃ raṃ/ sprin nag po bsdus bsdus/ ser ba phri hril shar phob/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na ser ba phrom phrom hril hril shar shar phob phob/ ces bye ba gcig las mi nyung ba ngag gcad de bzlas la ril bu la btab/ de nas ril bu dgu dgra'i zhing dkyil du bsregs/ ril bu lnga dgra'i lung pa de'i chu mig du sba/ ril bu bdun chu mig der khrag sna tshogs tshwa dang bsres la rgyun ring du bskol nas chu mig du mgo mjug ldog |des ni dgra'i lo thog thams cad ser bas 'joms so// zhag dgu las 'gyang mi srid do/ /yid ches so/ /sdig shin tu che'o/ /sa ma ya/ kha thaṃ/ rgya rgya rgya// ༈ /bcu bzhi pa sad 'bebs ni/ khyung sen/ mdze pho'i klad pa dang sen mo/ mi rus mi gcig pa bcu gsum gyi sen mo dang skra/ pi pi ling*/ pho ril rnams la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā lā a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/ sprin shig /sprin khrol/ chu bur sngon mo shigs/ char sprin sngon mo dengs phyir/ char chod nam mkha' sa gzhi mes bsregs raṃ/ 'bum tsho gcig bsngags la btab nas dgra'i zhing dkyil du bsreg go// des ni dgra'i lo tog thams cad sad kyis gzhom par 'gyur ro// zab rgya rgya/

༈ /bco lnga pa zas sbyor ha la nag po'i thabs ni/ btsan dug /si mu la/ thar nu/ g.yer ma/ nyi dga'/ gse zho/ ka ra/ rgun 'brum/ dan rog /dom mkhris/ rma bya'i mdongs/ star bu/ stag ma'i me tog /dbyi mong 'bras bu/ drod sman hril 'jong*/ ga pur/ sbal rog sha yi khog stod nyi mas tshad skam byas/ khog smad grib mar grib skam byas shing zla 'od la 'dug /de rnams ra rgya bo'i mchin pa shin tu rul ba dang sbyar te zangs sder kha sprod kyi nang du bcug /dug sna tshogs kyi lo ma dang lud bsres pa'i nang du bsnyal te langs pa'i tshe zangs sder gyi phyi 'ja' 'od sna tshogs 'byung*/ de tshe tshur bton la legs par bskams te/ nam dgos pa'i dus su dgra gang yin pa de la/ sran rdog tsam re bza' btung la sbyar nas btang bas/ phyi lo dus tshod de ma 'phyug par nad sna tshogs 'dus nas 'chi bar the tshom med do// shin tu zab bo// kha tham/ dha thim/ ༈ /bcu drug pa mdze gtong ba'i thabs ni/ sdig pa nag po'i sha| bse zho/ btsan dug /rgya tshwa/ dug sbrul gyi sha/ mdze khrag /yug sa'i mngal khrag /dbyi mong gi me tog de rnams 'o ma'am/ sbrang snod dang sbyar la zangs snod du lud kyi dkyil du bsnyal bas/ langs pa'i rtags ni skad pag pag zer ba 'byung ngo*// de dgra'i lus kyi cha gang yang rung bar byugs pas/ lo gcig las mi 'gyang ba mdze nag gis khyer ba the tshom med/ shin tu zab bo// rang gi sha rjen gyis ma reg pa gal che'o// rgya rgya rgyaḥ ak+thaṃ/ ༈ /bcu bdun pa smyo byed ni/ si ta mu la bskams te phye mar btags pa chang skyur ram/ kham skyur ram/ zho skyur gyi nang du btsos la rdza yi nang du phab btab la bsnyal bas langs pa'i rtags ni kha la bal khra 'byung ngo*// de grib skam byas la g.yer ma nyi dga' gnyis dang*/ khyi'am bong bu smyon pa'i snying mig mche ba dang sbyar nas/ dgra de'i bza' btung gang rung la sbyar nas btang bas/

myur du smyo nas rgyal khams skor bar byed do// shin tu zab// / ༈ /bco brgyad pa du ba rlung zhon ni/ bse zho/ btsan dug /thar nu/ thang shing gi 'bu/ srin bu me khyer/ gla rtsi/ ldong ros/ g.yer ma/ sdom sdig sbal sbrul bzhi'i sha/ mdze khrag /na yi bu mo stag bung ba/ phye ma leb/ byang pa nag po rnams sbyar te/ dgra'i me thab rnams su bsregs pa'i dud pas gang khyab pa'i lus can thams cad/ mig longs shing zla ba dgu tshun la 'gum par the tshom med do// sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya/ ༈ /bcu dgu pa klad srin gtong thabs ni/ bse zho/ mdze khrag /g.yer ma/ nyi dga'/ grog ma dmar nag gi sha/ thar nu rnams sbyar la/ dgra'i sna bug tu btang bas kho'i klad pa srin bu mang pos zos nas/ sdug shir 'gro ba the tshom med do// kha thaṃ/ dha thim/ ༈ /nyi shu pa lhog pa gtong ba ni/ bse zho/ btsan dug /thar nu/ sha ba'i tshil/ rta'i tshil rnams sbyar te dgra'i lus la byugs pas gang byugs sar lhog pas 'jus te/ myur du 'chi bar the tshom med do// zab bo// rgya rgya rgya/ ༈ /nyer gcig pa sha rul thabs ni/ bse zho/ btsan dug /dwa ba'i lo ma/ mi'i tshil/ ra'i mar rnams sbyar te/ dgra'i lus gang du byugs sar khol bur rul nas 'chi bar nges so// kha thaṃ/ sa ma ya/ ༈ /nyer gnyis pa hur gsod ni/ btsan dug /thar nu/ g.yer ma gsum sbyar te/ dgra'i bza' btung dang sbyar nas btang bas de ma thag tu 'chi'o// shin tu myur ro// zab bo/ rgya rgya rgya/ ༈ /nyer gsum pa 'brug gtad ni/ g.yer ma/ nyi dga'/ me tog ug chos/ ri bong gi sma ra rnams sbyar te/ dgra'i bza' btung dang sbyar nas btang bas/ 'brug bstud bstud par brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba yong nges so// shin tu nyams mtshar ro/ rgya rgya rgya/ de ltar gdams pa nyer gsum po 'di re res kyang dgra bo re re sgrol nus pa'i gdams pa kher tshug thub pa sha stag yin zhing mang po bsgril nas bsre lhad byed dgos pa ni ma yin no// 'di rnams kyi las byed pa la mgon po brgyad kyi bsnyen tshad thems pa gal che'o// shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa dgra bo sgrol byed 'di rnams mgon po brgyad kyi las mtha' dge slong dharma kīrtis shar kaḥthog tu sbyar ba'o//
